Assignment 05

Author

EPPS 6356 — Htoi San Roi

Published

October 25, 2025

I use Happy Index Data and do analysis.

First step is loading data

Code 
library(readxl)

# Load your file
hpi <- read_excel("HPI.xlsx")

# Inspect
head(hpi)

2(a) Histogram — Base R

Code 
hist(hpi$HPI,
     main = "Histogram of HPI",
     xlab = "HPI",
     col = "lightblue",
     border = "white",
     breaks = 20,
     cex.main = 1.5,
     cex.lab = 1.3)

2(b) Bar Chart — Vertical & Horizontal

Code 
hpi_bins <- cut(hpi$HPI, breaks = 10)
barplot(table(hpi_bins),
        main = "Bar Chart of HPI Bins",
        col = "skyblue",
        las = 2)
Code 
barplot(table(hpi_bins),
        horiz = TRUE,
        main = "Horizontal Bar Chart of HPI Bins",
        col = "orange")

2(c) Pie Chart — Base R

Code 
continent_counts <- table(hpi$Continent)

pie(continent_counts,
    main = "Distribution of Countries by Continent",
    col  = rainbow(length(continent_counts)),
    clockwise = TRUE)

2d. Boxplot

Code 
# Load your data
hpi <- read_excel("HPI.xlsx")

# Create a clean version without NA in HPI
hpi_clean <- subset(hpi, !is.na(HPI))
# Make sure hpi_clean exists
hpi_clean <- subset(hpi, !is.na(HPI))

boxplot(hpi_clean$HPI,
        main = "Boxplot of HPI",
        ylab = "HPI",
        col  = "lightgreen",
        border = "darkgreen")
Code 
boxplot(HPI ~ Continent, data = hpi_clean,
        main = "HPI by Continent",
        xlab = "Continent code",
        ylab = "HPI",
        col = "skyblue")

2e. Scatter Plot

Code 
plot(hpi_clean$`GDP per capita ($)`, hpi_clean$HPI,
     main = "HPI vs GDP per Capita",
     xlab = "GDP per capita ($)",
     ylab = "HPI",
     pch  = 19,
     col  = "purple")
